newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Suncorp directors resign due to merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Suncorp directors resign due to merger.

text.p: The chairman and two directors of Queensland state government-owned Suncorp Insurance and Finance said on Monday they had resigned because of the merger of their company with Metway Bank Ltd and Queensland Industry Development Corporation (QIDC).

"Some members of this (Suncorp) board are unable to form a view that the merger is in the best interests of Suncorp," chairman Graham Tucker and directors Ted Ranson and John Wruck said in a joint statement.

The Suncorp board members said they also had resigned because of "not being party to all the discussions and arrangements entered into between the government and Metway prior to the merger announcement."
The directors also said they were not "party to the plans and issues that have or may have emerged since then, and for other reasons."
"A matter such as this is for each director to contemplate, and to determine whether in the circumstances he or she is able to continue to act," the statement said.
"It clearly is not a matter upon which the board as a whole can decide," the directors' statement said.
The directors said they would deliver their written resignations to state treasurer Joan Sheldon later on Monday.
"This is the only public statement that will be made concerning these reasons for resigning," the directors said.
